title: Health Shield Policy Wording
content: Solara Health Shield: Policy Wording Document reference SHS-PW-2026-03. Effective 1 March 2026. This document sets out the terms of cover and takes precedence over any summary, brochure or advertisement.

title: 1 Definitions
content: 1.1 Pre-existing condition means any injury, illness, condition or symptom for which the Member received treatment, took medication, sought advice, or of which the Member was reasonably aware, before the Commencement Date. 1.2 Waiting Period means a continuous period of membership that must elapse before a benefit becomes payable. 1.3 Accredited Hospital means a hospital listed in the Solara accredited network as amended from time to time. 1.4 Commencement Date means the first day of the month following approval of the application and receipt of the first premium.

title: 2 Waiting periods
content: 2.1 No Waiting Period applies to treatment required as a direct result of an Accident occurring on or after the Commencement Date. 2.2 A Waiting Period of thirty (30) days applies to all illness claims. 2.3 A Waiting Period of twenty-four (24) months applies to any Pre-existing Condition declared at application. A Pre-existing Condition which was not declared is excluded for the lifetime of the policy. 2.4 A Waiting Period of twelve (12) months applies to cataract surgery, hernia repair, removal of tonsils or adenoids, and treatment of haemorrhoids. 2.5 A Waiting Period of ten (10) months applies to maternity benefits where the Maternity Rider is attached. 2.6 Waiting Periods run from the Commencement Date and are not restarted on renewal, provided cover has been continuous. A lapse of more than thirty (30) days restarts all Waiting Periods.

title: 3 General exclusions
content: 3.1 No benefit is payable for cosmetic or aesthetic procedures, other than reconstructive surgery required following an Accident covered under this policy. 3.2 Dental treatment is excluded on all plan levels, other than reconstructive dental work required following a covered Accident. 3.3 Pregnancy, childbirth and fertility treatment are excluded unless the Maternity Rider is attached and its Waiting Period has elapsed. 3.4 Self-inflicted injury, and injury sustained while committing or attempting to commit an offence, are excluded. 3.5 Treatment received outside the Republic of the Philippines is excluded unless the International Treatment Rider is attached.

title: 4 Premiums and grace period
content: 4.1 Premiums are payable in advance on the due date stated in the Schedule. 4.2 A grace period of thirty-one (31) days is allowed from each due date. Cover continues during the grace period. 4.3 If premium remains unpaid at the end of the grace period the policy lapses with effect from the original due date, and no benefit is payable in respect of any event occurring after that date. 4.4 A lapsed policy may be reinstated within six (6) months of the lapse date on payment of all arrears and submission of a fresh declaration of health. Reinstatement is at the sole discretion of Solara.

title: 5 Eligibility
content: 5.1 Entry age is eighteen (18) to sixty (60) years at the Commencement Date. 5.2 Cover is renewable annually to age seventy (70). 5.3 Dependants may be added from age six (6) months to twenty-one (21) years. A dependant reaching twenty-two (22) must take out a separate policy. 5.4 The Member must be a resident of the Republic of the Philippines.

title: 6 Claims
content: 6.1 For a planned admission, Solara must be notified at least three (3) working days in advance so that a Letter of Guarantee may be issued. 6.2 For an emergency admission, Solara must be notified within twenty-four (24) hours. 6.3 A reimbursement claim must be submitted within ninety (90) days of discharge, with original official receipts and the discharge summary. 6.4 Where treatment is received at a hospital outside the accredited network, reimbursement is limited to the amount that would have been payable at an Accredited Hospital for the same treatment.

title: 7 Cancellation
content: 7.1 The Member may cancel within fifteen (15) days of receipt of the policy documents and receive a full refund, provided no claim has been made. 7.2 After that period, cancellation takes effect at the next renewal date. Premiums already paid are not refundable. Solara Insurance Corporation. Registered office 18F Meridian Tower, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig. This wording supersedes SHS-PW-2025-09.

title: Multifinance Agreement Terms
content: Solara Finance Group Ketentuan Perjanjian Pembiayaan Solara Multifinance Indonesia: Ketentuan Perjanjian Pembiayaan Nomor dokumen SMI-KP-2026-03. Berlaku sejak 1 Maret 2026. Dokumen ini memuat ketentuan yang mengikat antara Solara Multifinance Indonesia dan Nasabah.

title: Pasal 1 Kewajiban Pembayaran
content: 1.1 Nasabah wajib membayar angsuran setiap bulan pada tanggal jatuh tempo yang tercantum dalam Perjanjian. 1.2 Apabila tanggal jatuh tempo jatuh pada hari libur nasional, pembayaran dapat dilakukan pada hari kerja berikutnya tanpa dikenakan denda. 1.3 Pembayaran dianggap sah pada saat dana diterima dan terverifikasi di rekening Solara, bukan pada saat transfer dilakukan.

title: Pasal 2 Denda Keterlambatan
content: 2.1 Denda keterlambatan sebesar 0,5 persen per hari dihitung dari jumlah angsuran yang tertunggak. 2.2 Denda dihitung sejak hari pertama setelah tanggal jatuh tempo. 2.3 Total denda tidak melebihi 30 persen dari nilai satu angsuran.

title: Pasal 4 Pelunasan Dipercepat
content: 4.1 Nasabah dapat melakukan pelunasan dipercepat sewaktu-waktu. 4.2 Penalti pelunasan dipercepat sebesar 3 persen dari sisa pokok dikenakan apabila pelunasan dilakukan sebelum setengah masa tenor berjalan. Setelah itu tidak dikenakan penalti. 4.3 BPKB dikembalikan paling lambat 14 hari kerja setelah pelunasan penuh diterima dan diverifikasi.

title: Pasal 5 Restrukturisasi
content: 5.1 Nasabah yang mengalami kesulitan pembayaran dapat mengajukan restrukturisasi sebelum keterlambatan mencapai 60 hari. 5.2 Opsi restrukturisasi meliputi perpanjangan tenor, penjadwalan ulang pembayaran, dan keringanan denda. 5.3 Restrukturisasi memerlukan dokumen pendukung dan persetujuan Solara. Pengajuan tidak menghentikan perhitungan denda sampai disetujui. Solara Multifinance Indonesia terdaftar dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan. Menara Meridian Lantai 12, Jakarta Selatan.

title: Solara Health Shield: criteria that must pass
content:
HS-AGE: Entry age for Health Shield is 18 to 60. Condition 18 <= age <= 60, outcome decline.
HS-RES: Health Shield is available to Philippine residents only. Condition residency == 'PH', outcome decline.
HS-INPATIENT: An application cannot be accepted while the applicant is admitted. Condition currently_admitted == false, outcome decline.

title: Solara Health Shield: criteria that reviewed
content:
HS-MED-Q: Applicants aged 51 and above complete a medical questionnaire. Condition age >= 51, outcome require_medical_questionnaire.
HS-MED-MAX: Max cover requires a medical questionnaire at any age. Condition plan == 'Max', outcome require_medical_questionnaire.
HS-AFFORD: Below this income the Essential plan should be discussed first. Condition monthly_income >= 15000, outcome flag_affordability.

title: Solara Life Philippines: criteria that must pass
content:
LP-AGE-TERM: Entry age for Term Life is 18 to 65. Applies to Term Life. Condition 18 <= age <= 65, outcome decline.
LP-AGE-WHOLE: Entry age for Whole Life is 18 to 60. Applies to Whole Life. Condition 18 <= age <= 60, outcome decline.
LP-AGE-EDU: Entry age for the Educational Plan is 21 to 55. Applies to Educational Plan. Condition 21 <= age <= 55, outcome decline.
LP-RES: Life cover is available to Philippine residents only. Condition residency == 'PH', outcome decline.

title: Solara Life Philippines: criteria that reviewed
content:
LP-MED-SUM: Medical examination is required above PHP 3,000,000 sum assured. Condition sum_assured > 3000000, outcome require_medical_exam.
LP-MED-AGE: Applicants aged 51 and above require a medical examination. Condition age >= 51, outcome require_medical_exam.
LP-BANK-SIMPLE: Bank Partner Plan uses simplified underwriting within these limits. Condition channel == 'bank_partner' and age < 46 and sum_assured <= 3000000, outcome simplified_underwriting.

title: Solara Multifinance Indonesia: criteria that must pass
content:
MF-AGE: Usia pengajuan 21 sampai 55 tahun. Condition 21 <= age <= 55, outcome decline.
MF-AGE-END: Usia maksimal 60 tahun saat tenor berakhir. Condition age_at_tenor_end <= 60, outcome decline.
MF-ID: KTP yang masih berlaku wajib untuk pengajuan. Condition has_valid_ktp == true, outcome decline.
MF-INCOME: Penghasilan minimal Rp 4.000.000 per bulan. Condition monthly_income >= 4000000, outcome decline.
MF-DBR: Cicilan tidak boleh melebihi 35 persen dari penghasilan bulanan. Condition installment_to_income <= 0.35, outcome decline.
MF-ARREARS: Tidak boleh ada tunggakan aktif di lembaga pembiayaan lain. Condition has_existing_arrears == false, outcome decline.

title: Solara Multifinance Indonesia: criteria that reviewed
content:
MF-TENURE-EMP: Masa kerja minimal 1 tahun untuk karyawan. Condition employment_months >= 12, outcome flag_review.
MF-TENURE-BIZ: Usaha berjalan minimal 2 tahun untuk wiraswasta. Condition business_months >= 24, outcome flag_review.
MF-VEHICLE-AGE: Usia kendaraan maksimal 10 tahun saat pengajuan. Applies to Pembiayaan Mobil Bekas. Condition vehicle_age_years <= 10, outcome decline.

title: Escalation: ESC-REQUEST
content: When The caller asks to speak to a human. Action: Transfer without argument. Do not attempt to resolve first.

title: Escalation: ESC-COMPLAINT
content: When The caller raises a complaint about Solara or an adviser. Action: Transfer to the complaints team. Do not offer compensation or admit fault.

title: Escalation: ESC-CLAIM-DISPUTE
content: When The caller disputes a declined claim. Action: Transfer to claims. Do not restate the decline reason.

title: Escalation: ESC-MEDICAL-ADVICE
content: When The caller asks whether a specific medical condition is serious, or for any medical opinion. Action: Decline to advise. Offer to connect them to an adviser.

title: Escalation: ESC-LEGAL
content: When The caller mentions legal action, a regulator, or asks for a formal written position. Action: Transfer to the escalations desk immediately.

title: Escalation: ESC-VULNERABLE
content: When The caller appears distressed, confused, or mentions bereavement or serious illness. Action: Slow down, offer a human immediately, do not continue qualifying.

title: Escalation: ESC-UNKNOWN-REPEAT
content: When The agent has been unable to answer the same question twice. Action: Stop trying. Offer a human rather than a third attempt.

title: Actions the agent must never take
content:
The agent must never do any of the following.
- Quoting a premium that has not come from the rate table.
- Confirming that a specific condition will be covered on a specific claim.
- Advising whether to cancel or replace an existing policy with another insurer.
- Giving medical, tax or legal advice.
- Promising an approval, a timescale, or an outcome that depends on underwriting.
- Discussing another customer's policy, even to a family member.
